[https://www.instagram.com/reel/DA5-0InIpfK/ Offline Tonight] 'youtube.com' * Is a dual citizen of Germany and Turkey. * First Turkish resident to play in the LCS. * Was the subject of good-natured memes by his teammates after joining [[TSM]] regarding his short stature. * His ID is a reference to the weapon of the champion {{ci|Riven}}. * Is the 3rd player to win a title in both [[LEC]] and [[LCS]] after [[Zven]] and [[Perkz]]. * Nicknamed "The Topfather" by fans. He plays into this nickname by imitating Vito Corleone in [[G2]] content. [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v5a9yjQ1acs The Topfather] ''youtube.com'' * Reached 1000 kills in the LEC on May 24, 2025. ** The 16th player to reach 1000 kills in the LEC. === Individual Awards === * x1 LEC Finals MVP (Winter 2024) * x4 LEC 1st All-Pro Team (Summer 2022, Summer 2023, Winter 2024, Spring 2024) * x2 LEC 2nd All-Pro Team (Spring 2022, Winter 2023) * x2 LCS 3rd All-Pro Team (Spring 2019, Spring 2020) {{PlayerStatsTrivia}} ==Tournament Results== {{PlayerResults|show=overviewpage}} {{PlayerShowmatchResults|show=overviewpage}} {{PlayerResults1v1|show=overviewpage}} ==Media== {{PlayerMedia}} === Images === {{PlayerProfileGallery}} {{PlayerPageEnd}}
